documentation: Types are used by the game to apply certain bonuses/maluses on movement/combat etc.
Addition to defence roll in combat in this terrain
Multiplier to increase or decrease combat width in this terrain
Multiplier to movement time into/out of province with terrain
Extra cost multiplier when picked in the Nation Designer
province id = rotation in degrees, 0 is pointing right, then ccw
There is an unknown minimum number required due to a paradox bug. If a custom map is crashing try a higher number.
